description: Update the SEO meta for a taxonomy term (partial; null deletes a field). Returns the term's full SEO meta.

description.description: Meta description. null deletes the stored value.

og_image.description: Open Graph image attachment ID. null deletes the stored value.

robots.description: Robots directives, comma separated (e.g. "noindex,nofollow"). null deletes the stored value.

schema.description: Custom JSON-LD (object, array or JSON string); overrides schema_type. Invalid JSON is stored as []. null deletes the stored value.

title.description: SEO title (template tokens like %title%, %sep%, %sitename% allowed). null deletes the stored value.

name: seo_update_term_seo
